newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Desertstone knows no reason for rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Desertstone knows no reason for rise.

text.p: Gold explorer Desertstone NL said on Thursday it was unaware of any reason for the recent increase in its share price other than market speculation on the progress of its drilling programme.
Desertstone's share price nearly doubled in early trade on Thursday to reach 52 cents before the company requested a trading halt.
Concurrent with the company's statement on the share price, it released a drilling report from its Lake Torrens project in the fashionable Gawler Craton region in South Australia.

The company said a field report based on visual examination of drill cuttings indicated a 37 metre interval from 103 metres to 140 metres containing sulphide mineralisation with visible gold tentatively identified in one sample within that zone.
Desertstone said results could not be confirmed until such time as assay results were available.
Brokers confirmed that speculation about this possible intersection had driven the explorer's shares in active trade.
Desertstone shares closed 110 percent higher at 60 cents on turnover of 3.6 million shares.
